svg.title: Both target configurations remain near 50 frames per second
svg.desc: Empirical cumulative distribution from the two original target CPU CSVs. The plotted quantity is completed-frame interval, distinct from the terminal frame_start-to-end cost. No GPU durations exist in the header-only GPU CSVs.

g.text: Both target configurations remain near 50 frames per second
Empirical CDF of recorded interval_ms, excluding frame indices 0..59; GPU CSVs contain no samples.
Horizontal range 10..40 ms; rare values outside this range remain in the CDF denominator.
CPU loop intervals are not physical scanout. Similar distributions do not establish causality.
